486dbec620.q: How did Suzanna Valdez Wolfe navigate pursuing higher education as a young Latina with family expectations?
486dbec620.a: She started at Texas Women's University as a freshman because it was an all-girls university that her family felt was safe. After one year she returned home and completed two years at UTEP, then worked full-time for a year before returning to school at Pan American University, now UTRGB. She emphasizes that college journeys are not always straight lines and that finding your why makes the pursuit worth it.
